launch_cutline.description: A lane publishes at or above the cutline only when its version-bump impact is disclosed, its publish-target descriptor and diff payload are shared verbatim across human review and headless plan, its auth source and target scope are disclosed and never ambient before mutation, its dry-run preview is current, its rollout ring is disclosed, a rollback target is recorded, its proof packet is within SLO, and it is owner-signed; otherwise it narrows below stable.

stop_rules.title: Version impact undisclosed
stop_rules.rationale: A version bump that hides migration or compatibility impact behind a version number narrows the lane.

stop_rules.title: Auth source undisclosed
stop_rules.rationale: A publication that does not disclose its auth source and target scope before mutation narrows the lane.

stop_rules.title: Ambient credential inheritance
stop_rules.rationale: A publish flow that would inherit ambient credentials invisibly narrows the lane.

stop_rules.title: Dry-run preview unavailable
stop_rules.rationale: A lane whose dry-run preview is missing, stale, or failed narrows below the cutline.

stop_rules.title: Descriptor parity broken
stop_rules.rationale: Human review and headless publication must share the same publish-target descriptor.

stop_rules.title: Diff payload parity broken
stop_rules.rationale: Human review and headless publication must share the same diff payload.

stop_rules.title: Rollout ring undisclosed
stop_rules.rationale: A lane that does not disclose its rollout ring narrows below the cutline.

stop_rules.title: Rollback target missing
stop_rules.rationale: A lane without a recorded rollback target cannot be published as one reversible system.

stop_rules.title: Proof packet stale
stop_rules.rationale: A proof packet outside its freshness SLO narrows the lane.

stop_rules.title: Proof packet missing
stop_rules.rationale: A lane without a captured proof packet narrows below the cutline.

stop_rules.title: Owner sign-off missing
stop_rules.rationale: A lane without owner sign-off cannot hold its claimed label.

stop_rules.title: Waiver expired
stop_rules.rationale: A lane relying on an expired waiver narrows below the cutline.

publication.rationale: Every release-blocking lane at or above the cutline shares one descriptor and diff payload across human review and headless plan, discloses an explicit non-ambient auth source and target scope before mutation, rides a current dry-run preview, discloses its rollout ring, and records a rollback target; the managed-output lane already inherits a below-cutline claim, so it narrows without blocking the train.
